items.headline: Italy fines generator €5m for REMIT breach
items.summary: Italian regulator ARERA sanctioned a market participant for withholding generation capacity when profitable, in breach of REMIT Article 5 on market manipulation.

items.headline: Agentic AI moves into CTRM operations teams
items.summary: Industry analysts note agentic AI is shifting from hype to practical use in commodity trading operations, with vendors targeting workflow automation in reporting and settlement processes.

items.headline: Record-low Rhine still squeezing chemical shippers
items.summary: Persistent low water at the Kaub chokepoint has pushed chemical majors including BASF to declare force majeure on some products and shift volumes to rail and specialized low-draft barges.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer has moved into commodity trade finance, disclosing roughly $1.5 billion in credit extended to commodity traders with plans to scale further.
